documents.title: Updates on Notice of Offer for Sale of shares by Promoter (Oversubscription)
Notice of Offer for Sale of shares by Promoter & Floor Price
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Sri Lotus Developers reported a strong performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by robust pre-sales growth and high profitability. Management highlighted that luxury demand in Mumbai remains resilient despite interest rate hikes, supported by end-user upgrades and scarce prime land. The company added three new projects during the quarter and plans four more launches in the second half of the year. Backed by a net cash position and stable margins, the company remains confident in meeting its full-year guidance. Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited reported a strong first half of FY27, with Q2 FY27 pre-sales growing 83% year-on-year to INR 470 Crs and H1 FY27 pre-sales reaching INR 879 Crs.

guidance.claim: The company remains confident of delivering its FY27 pre-sales guidance ranging from INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores.
guidance.quote: Together with the momentum from our recent launches and a growing pipeline, we remain confident of delivering our FY27 guideline of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60% over FY26 levels.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA and PAT margins to stay between 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively, for FY27.
guidance.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining strong profitability, with EBITDA and PAT margin expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.

guidance.claim: The company remains confident of delivering its stated guidance for FY27 of pre-sales of INR 1,800-2,000 Crs, and revenue and PAT growth of 55-60% over FY26 levels.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of delivering our stated guidance for FY27 of a pre-sales of INR 1,800-2,000 Crs, and revenue and PAT growth of 55-60% over FY26 levels.

guidance.claim: Management remains committed to its FY27 pre-sales guidance ranging from INR1,800 to 2,000 crores.
guidance.quote: Backed by this launch pipeline, strong demand outlook, and the quality of our developments, we remain committed to our FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.

guidance.claim: EBITDA and PAT margins are expected to be at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of sustaining strong profitability with EBITDA and PAT margins expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that Mumbai remains India's largest housing market, with sales in the first nine months of calendar 2026 reaching their highest since 2018.
demand_outlook.quote: Mumbai remains India’s largest housing market, with sales in the first nine months of calendar 2026 at their highest since 2018, and the luxury segment continues to lead.

demand_outlook.claim: Prime residential prices rose by 6.2% year-on-year in the first half of the calendar year.
demand_outlook.quote: In the first half of the calendar year, sales of homes priced above INR10 crores reached a record of over INR18,500 crores, while prime residential prices rose 6.2% year-on-year, more than twice the global average.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand is primarily driven by end users upgrading to larger homes in better locations.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand is driven largely by end users upgrading to larger homes in better locations, while scarce land in prime micromarkets makes redevelopment the principal route to new supply, precisely where Lotus has built its capability.

demand_outlook.claim: Management does not expect the recent RBI repo rate hike to materially alter demand in their operating micromarkets.
demand_outlook.quote: We, therefore, do not expect it to materially alter demand in the micromarkets we operate in.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted good momentum for commercial properties in the market.
demand_outlook.quote: So, yes, there is a good moment for commercial properties, and we have very balanced portfolio of commercial.

demand_outlook.claim: There is strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces at the GIFT City Area project.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces, coupled with differentiated project positioning and strong brand name translating into high enquiry levels for luxury residential units.

demand_outlook.claim: Q2 FY27 pre-sales grew 83% YoY to INR 470 Crs, showing that demand is spread across the portfolio rather than resting on a single project.
demand_outlook.quote: Q2 FY27 pre-sales grew 83% YoY to INR 470 Crs, with six projects contributing, which shows that demand is spread across the portfolio rather than resting on a single project.

demand_outlook.claim: Luxury housing demand across Mumbai has grown by more than 11%.
demand_outlook.quote: Mumbai is a good example of this. Even as the overall housing market has moderated, luxury housing demand across the city has grown by more than 11%, led by successful families and professionals upgrading to bigger, better homes.

demand_outlook.claim: Supply in micro-markets like Worli, Bandra, and South Mumbai remains constrained with very little fresh land left.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, supply in micro-markets like Worli, Bandra, and South Mumbai remain constrained. There is very little fresh land left, so most new luxury supply comes through redevelopment, rather than greenfield construction.

capex_expansion.claim: The company added three new projects during the quarter: Lotus Impressa, Lotus Stellar, and Lotus Supremus.
capex_expansion.quote: Three new projects added, Lotus Impressa at Shivaji Park in Dadar West, Lotus Stellar in Versova, and Lotus Supremus in Juhu, which adds INR2,700 to INR2,800 crores of GDV to existing GDV pipeline.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to launch four projects in the second half of the year.
capex_expansion.quote: We plan to launch four projects, Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to INR4,000 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company was appointed as preferred developer for three new projects adding INR 2,700-2,800 Crs of GDV.
capex_expansion.quote: We also made significant progress on business development during the quarter, where company was appointed as preferred developer for three new projects: Lotus Supremus (Juhu), Lotus Empressa (Shivaji Park, Dadar West), Lotus Stellar (Versova) and additional area secured for Lotus Insignia which together adds INR 2,700-2,800 Crs of GDV.

capex_expansion.claim: The GIFT City Area mixed-use project has an estimated GDV of INR 2,000-2,200 Crs with expected commencement in Q1 FY28 and expected completion in FY31.
capex_expansion.quote:
Completion Timeline: FY31
❖ Expected Commencement: Q1 FY28
❖ Estimated GDV: INR 2,000-2,200 Crs

capex_expansion.claim: During the quarter, the company launched two new projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, representing a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we launched two new projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, together representing a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company was appointed developer for a commercial redevelopment project in Juhu with an estimated GDV of INR1,600 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We were also recently appointed developer for a very, very prestigious commercial redevelopment project with an estimated GDV of INR1,600 crores in Juhu.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27 with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to 4,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we plan to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27: Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to 4,000 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 FY27 EBITDA more than doubled to INR107 crores with margins expanding to 39.9%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA more than doubled to INR107 crores, with margins expanding to 39.9%.

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY27 EBITDA stood at INR155 crores with a margin of 38.80%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased 95% to INR155 crores, with a healthy margin of 38.80%.

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY27 PAT margin improved to 33.5%.
margins_costs.quote: For the first half, revenue stood at INR401 crores, up 69%, EBITDA at INR155 crores, up 95%, and PAT at INR134 crores, up 86% at an improved PAT margin of 33.5%.

margins_costs.claim: In Q2 FY27, EBITDA more than doubled to INR 107 Crs at a margin of 39.9%.
margins_costs.quote: In Q2, total revenue rose 53% YoY to INR 269 Crs, EBITDA more than doubled to INR 107 Crs at a margin of 39.9%, and PAT grew 91% to INR 89 Crs.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin is approximately 25%-30% on a consistent basis.
margins_costs.quote:
PAT Margin (%)
~ 25%-30%
on a consistent basis

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 profit after tax grew 77% year-on-year to INR46 crores at a PAT margin of 34.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax grew 77% year-on-year to INR46 crores, at a PAT margin of 34.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA stood at INR48 crores with an EBITDA margin of 36.4%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR48 crores, growing 63% year-on-year with a healthy EBITDA margin of 36.4%.

margins_costs.claim: Average selling price stood at INR86,000 per square foot during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Our average selling price stood at INR86,000 per square foot, underscoring the strength of our product across the micro-markets we operate in.

orders_capacity.claim: The ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: With these additions, our ongoing and upcoming pipeline now comprises 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores, of which 19 are redevelopment-led.

orders_capacity.claim: Lotus Trident contributed pre-sales of INR178 crores in its first full quarter since launch.
orders_capacity.quote: Lotus Trident in Andheri West, our luxury commercial offering, has been a standout performer, contributing pre-sales of INR178 crores in its first full quarter since its launch at the end of June.

orders_capacity.claim: Pre-sales for Q2 FY27 stood at INR470 crores, up 83% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Delighted to share that we recorded pre-sales for the quarter at INR470 crores, up 83% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Total saleable area across the current project portfolio is approximately 3.5 mn. sq. ft.
Seventeen out of the 22 projects in the pipeline are redevelopment-led.
orders_capacity.quote: Notably, 17 of these 22 projects are redevelopment-led, reinforcing our core focus and competitive strength in this segment.

capital_allocation.claim: As of September 30, 2026, the company had a net cash position of INR494 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of 30th September 2026, we had a net cash position of INR494 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Estimated project-level surplus stands at approximately INR9,500 crores over the development cycle of the portfolio.
capital_allocation.quote: In addition, our estimated project-level surplus stands at approximately INR9,500 crores over the development cycle of our portfolio.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised approximately INR792 crores through the fresh issue of its IPO, with net proceeds of approximately INR732 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We raised approximately INR792 crores through the fresh issue of our IPO, with net proceeds of approximately INR732 crores after issue expenses, of which INR550 crores earmarked for our subsidiary for the Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of the IPO proceeds, INR305 crores had been deployed as on September 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: INR305 crores had been deployed as on 30th September 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Fresh issue proceeds from the IPO of INR 792 Crs are used for investment in subsidiaries for part-funding development and construction costs of ongoing projects Amalfi, The Arcadian, and Varun amounting to ~INR 550 Crs.
capital_allocation.quote:
Fresh Issue of INR 792 Crs.
Use of proceeds
❖ Investment in our Subsidiaries, Richfeel Real Estate Private Limited, Dhyan Projects Private Limited and Tryksha Real Estate Private Limited for part-funding development and construction cost of our Ongoing Projects, Amalfi, The Arcadian and Varun, respectively amounting to ~INR 550 Crs.

capital_allocation.claim: As of June 2026, the company had a total cash balance of approximately INR776 crores against debt of INR153 crores, resulting in a net cash position of INR623 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of June 2026, we had a total cash balance of approximately INR776 crores against debt of INR153 crores, resulting in a net cash position of INR623 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of INR550 crores earmarked for the subsidiary towards Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun, INR271 crores has been deployed as on 30th June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Of the INR550 crores earmarked for our subsidiary towards Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun, we have deployed INR271 crores as on 30th June 2026, and the utilization remains in line with our planned deployment schedule.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the RBI repo rate hike is likely to weigh on affordable and mid-income housing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Earlier this month, RBI raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.5%, its first increase since early 2023. While this is likely to weigh on affordable and mid-income housing, the luxury segment is far less sensitive to borrowing costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are not guarantees of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantees of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

management_commitments.quote: We plan to launch four projects, Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to INR4,000 crores.

management_commitments.quote: And our intention to complete these projects for next four, four and a half years.

management_commitments.quote: Backed by this launch pipeline, strong demand outlook, and the quality of our developments, we remain committed to our FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.

management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we plan to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27: Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to 4,000 crores.
